question: In a patient diagnosed with pneumonia and with metaneumonic pleural effusion in 2/3 of the right hemithorax, which of the following sign associations is frequent to observe?

options.opa: Normal vesicular murmur - normal vocal vibrations-matt percussion.
options.opb: Diminished vesicular murmur - increased vocal vibrations - percussion mate.
options.opc: Rattles - increased vocal vibrations matt impact.
options.opd: Diminished vesicular murmur - diminished vocal vibrations - percussion mate.
